infrastructure.name: CFO Cockpit Client-Server Phase — HYOK-Encrypted Hosting + shadcn/ui Front-End Rebuild
infrastructure.notes: BACKLOG 2026-07-04 (CEO+PA architecture/security thread, resolved same day as INI-123's closing note). Realizes the Phase D carve-out INI-123 explicitly deferred: interactivity + write-back requiring a live backend. Architecture = HYOK (Hold-Your-Own-Key): Vercel-hosted app + managed Postgres store the v2 contract as field-level envelope-encrypted records; Clerk auth with mandatory server-side session verification; a key-custody service on the Mac mini reachable only via a narrowly-scoped tunnel holds the master key — ciphertext may live in someone else's cloud, the key never does. CEO also directed the front end be REBUILT on shadcn/ui (Next.js + Tailwind + shadcn component library, shadcn MCP available for build sessions) rather than carried forward as the plain HTML/CSS shell INI-123 ships — this is the first JasonOS surface with a real React build pipeline, adopted deliberately as the go-to pattern for future app-like (not document-like) surfaces. Includes, as a first-class deliverable: a synthetic-data build discipline + credential-revocation/cutover runbook, reusable beyond this build as a JCD client-engagement asset (candidate anonymized case study).

infrastructure.name: Cowork Auto-Memory Migration → governance/memory/ + Terminal Closure Decoupling
infrastructure.notes: BACKLOG 2026-07-04 (follow-on from PCR-OPS-033 § 6a). PCR-OPS-033 made governance/memory/ (Operations repo) the canonical, environment-agnostic store for JasonOS organizational memory and retired Cowork's proprietary auto-memory as authoritative going forward. This initiative migrates the RELEVANT historical content out of the ~179-file Cowork auto-memory store into governance/memory/ — a CURATED pass, not a 1:1 copy. Real scope discovered while drafting the PCR (original ~35 estimate was wrong): the 179 files mix genuine JasonOS-org-operational knowledge (migrate) with client/creative-pipeline entries, personal identities, and stale per-initiative retrospectives that should already have been deleted under the no-duplicate-portfolio-memory rule (do NOT migrate — evaluate for deletion or relocation to the appropriate KB/vault surface per policies/knowledge/information-placement-policy.md). A blind copy would import stale material into the new store on day one. Explicitly NOT part of PCR-OPS-033's own completion — the PCR only repointed future writes; this moves the backlog. SCOPE EXPANDED 2026-07-04 (CEO direction): once the store is terminal-reachable, the Initiative Closure Protocol's sole remaining Cowork dependency (step 2b memory reconciliation, PCR-OPS-032) disappears — so this initiative also carries the closure decoupling to completion: audit the whole closure workflow for any other Cowork-only tie, then land a PCR (CEO-ratified) that repoints prepare-close.py step 2b at governance/memory/ and reverses the closure-is-Cowork-only rule PCR-OPS-033 just enacted. The migration is INI work; the policy flip is PCR-gated and DoD-gated on the migration being verified complete.
